unlisted_practices: Using LLMs to extract structured data from discharge letters, followed by rule-based patient subtyping and trial eligibility assessment for deterministic, interpretable outputs

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an LLM pipeline deployed within a hospital infrastructure on a sample of 100 cardiology discharge letters to extract clinical variables for trial recruitment, validating model extraction accuracy against ground-truth templates without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
